div.span: Every backend request has a timeout and an inline error with Retry; initialisers start work in the background and return, so a reopened window is never blank for good. The agent keeps sampling and raising alarms after the app exits.

text.tspan: Every backend request has a timeout and an inline error with Retry; initialisers start work in the background and return, so a reopened window is never blank for good. The agent
keeps sampling and raising alarms after the app exits.
